ideas.idea: Add address and directions text to the visit page, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The visit page description says 'Opening times and directions' but the body has only opening days, so the gap is real and fixable.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD for address and hours on the visit page
ideas.why: It is accurate but optional, and the deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Give each apple variety its own page and URL
ideas.why: The varieties page claims over forty varieties but lists only two, so individual pages would give people and machines something specific to find and cite.

ideas.idea: Add in-text links from the home page to the varieties and visit pages
ideas.why: The pages are already linked from the site-wide nav, so body links add little.
It is accurate, since the sitemap has no lastmod, but it is a small signal that applies to almost any site and the site has only three pages.
